events.title: Beta Testing
events.summary: Hey everyone!We were planning to launch the Tandem Together Playtest today, but unfortunately we’ve run into a small delay.The playtest is currently still waiting for approval from steam, which means we can’t start it just yet.Everything on our side is ready, and we’re aiming to go live asap. As soon as we have confirmation, we’ll post another update here.Thanks for your patience, and we’re really looking forward to finally seeing you play Tandem Together! 💛See you soon!
